lines.en: I drift along without touching the ground.

lines.zh: 网挂在我身上，一晃一晃。
lines.en: The web on me sways and sways.
I slide past behind you.
My path curves and doubles back.
Now I am near, now I am far.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙走，一直看着你。
lines.en: I keep to the wall, always watching you.
My shadow lags behind me.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，火把暗了一点。
lines.en: Torches dim where I pass.

lines.zh: 我离地半尺，慢慢移过去。
lines.en: I move half a foot off the floor, slowly.
I drift along your line.
I cross an empty corridor.
I stop behind you without a sound.
My tendrils hang, slowly moving.

lines.zh: 我在你睡着的时候最清醒。
lines.en: I am most awake while you sleep.
My hands stay raised.
The dreams here are thin.

lines.zh: 你每吞一次口水，我都数着。
lines.en: I count every swallow you take.

lines.zh: 我没有脸，你也能认出我。
lines.en: I have no face, and still you know me.
I am waiting for that lamp to go out.

lines.zh: 我离你的枕头只差一尺。
lines.en: I'm a foot from your pillow.
I know this room well.

lines.zh: 我的手指从你额前收了回来。
lines.en: My fingers withdraw from your brow.

lines.zh: 我什么也不吃，我只收集。
lines.en: I eat nothing; I only collect.
I am listening to you dream.

lines.zh: 我就在你面前，你却看不清。
lines.en: I am right before you, and you cannot see me clearly.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的时候，我近了一步。
lines.en: While you blinked, I came a step closer.
Your eyes are trying to focus.
I reach out and stop beside your face.
Do not fall asleep, whatever you do.
Sleep, and I come in.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，你没有听见。
lines.en: I smile, and you did not hear it.
I am in your dreams too.

lines.zh: 我一刻也没离开你身边。
lines.en: I have not left your side for an instant.
There is no need to look back for me.
I kept watch over you a long while.
The light in your eyes disperses.
I can see the sleep in your eyes.
Holding on a little longer will not help.
I set my hand on your shoulder.
You have heard me already.
My voice is not in the air.

lines.zh: 你看的每一处，我都不在。
lines.en: Everywhere you look, I am not there.

lines.zh: 我就在你看不到的地方。
lines.en: I am exactly where you cannot see.

lines.zh: 我退了一下，形状散了点。
lines.en: I recoil and my shape blurs.
My tendrils draw in.
I hang there and do not retreat far.

lines.zh: 这个伤对我来说很陌生。
lines.en: This kind of wound is unfamiliar to me.

lines.zh: 我发出一声几乎听不见的响。
lines.en: I made a sound almost too faint to hear.
I press in again.

lines.zh: 你的手里有东西能伤我。
lines.en: You carry something that hurts me.
I will not come quite that close again.
You offer food to a dream.
That does not exist for me.
I need only for you to close your eyes.
I turn my face away.
That smell will not hold me.
Keep it for yourself.
The more awake you are, the harder this is.

lines.zh: 你把它吃了，也许会睡着。
lines.en: Eat it, and perhaps you will sleep.
You strike nothing but air.
I draw back one step and press in again.

lines.zh: 我的手从你肩上穿过去。
lines.en: My hand passes through your shoulder.
All you feel is cold.
I tilt my head and do not flinch.
That means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候，我还在原地。
lines.en: When you pull away, I am still there.
My shadow reached you first.
You shivered.
I have no such thing.
That is not how we multiply.
I only enter dreams.
I tilt my head and do not answer.
You should not ask a dream that.
I withdraw slowly.
One of my tendrils moves.
Only breathing answers in this room.
There is other work tonight.
I look into your eyes.

lines.zh: 我伸手，东西就浮起来了。
lines.en: I reach out and it rises.
It passes through my hand.
I set it back down.
This is not a thing from a dream.
I put it back into your hand.
I have taken this one.
I can keep this.

lines.zh: 梦里的东西，也能捡起来吗？
lines.en: Can you pick up something out of a dream?
I stop and turn.
You have finally noticed me.
The air has suddenly gone cold.
I need not come very close.
Your eyes are nearly shut.
I am in front of your eyes.
This stretch of dream is mine.
Your eyelids are falling.
Of them all, you.
You will not sleep well tonight.
I reach toward your brow.
I smile, and you do not see.
Listen; someone is calling you.

lines.zh: 你走进卧室，我也跟着进去。
lines.en: You enter the bedroom; I follow.
Change rooms; I am there too.
The end of the corridor is still me.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸贴着你后脑的头发。
lines.en: My breath touches the hair at the back of your head.
I set my hand at the back of your neck.
Every step you take, I take one.
I speak at your ear.

lines.zh: 你的视野边缘有东西在动。
lines.en: Something moves at the edge of your sight.
I have no need to chase you.
You look back, and there is nothing.
I am in your dream the whole time.
The lamps go out one by one.

lines.zh: 你已经分不清醒着还是睡着。
lines.en: You can no longer tell waking from sleeping.

lines.zh: 你眼皮越来越沉，我不催。
lines.en: Your eyelids droop; I don't hurry you.
Your steps are growing unsteady.
The web I weave catches dreams.
Hold on a little longer.
And then you will close your eyes.
I can wait as long as it takes.
My hand presses on your face.
That was cold, not painful.
I pull at something.
Your eyelids sink.
There is no blade in my hand.

lines.zh: 你听见有人在叫你名字。
lines.en: You hear someone calling your name.
That came from inside you.
Your hand closes on air.
I need very little force.
You have steadied yourself again.

lines.zh: 这一次我多留了一会儿。
lines.en: This time I stayed longer.
Your breath has lost its rhythm.
This time I seize you from inside the dream.
Your eyelids are sinking.

lines.zh: 灯闪了一下，我就站在那儿了。
lines.en: The lamp flickered, and I was standing there.
I appear behind the mirror first.
The room has grown a little colder.
I have come out of a dream.

lines.zh: 捕梦网的影子，先落在地上。
lines.en: The dreamcatcher's shadow lands on the ground first.

lines.zh: 你在半梦半醒之间看见我。
lines.en: You see me between sleep and waking.
I stand in the doorway without a sound.
My tendrils extend slowly.
Someone here is dreaming.

lines.zh: 我从帘子后面显出身形。
lines.en: I take shape from behind the curtain.
There is a faint sweetness in the air.

lines.zh: 我从床脚的阴影里坐起来。
lines.en: I sit up from the shadow at your bed's foot.
You are not asleep yet; good.
Waiting does not tire me.
This room is very quiet.
My shape is not quite right.
I hang half a foot off the floor.
I counted three breaths.
There is wind outside; none in here.
The light of the fire scatters me.

lines.zh: 我掉下去的时候，形状拉得很长。
lines.en: As I fall, my shape stretches long.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的形状散在水里。
lines.en: Water floods in and my shape spreads through it.

lines.zh: 爆光把整个屋子照亮，我退到墙角。
lines.en: The blast lights the room and I retreat to the corner.
Some force pins me where I stand.

lines.zh: 这里没有梦，我也撑不住了。
lines.en: There are no dreams here, and I cannot last.

lines.zh: 白光劈下来，我一下子散开。
lines.en: White lightning falls and I come apart.
I fall somewhere with no dreams.
